svg.text: d2s_mpdda_pd: matched-pair DDA (4 x unit_r2), folded cascode, class-AB drive of the output gates a / b, digital enable en_3v3 / en_3v3_b
frozen .subckt defaults: lcas = 3 (CX, CY, PCL, PCR 30u / 3u ng=2), rl = 50.6u (in unit_r2.sch: 4 x rhigh 0.5u / 12.65u in series)
d2s_mpdda (../../improvements/xschem) plus the [E] switches; unit_r2.sym from ../../improvements/xschem; block descriptions: README.md there and here
[1] DDA units A, B, C1, C2: split-tail PMOS pair, rhigh between the sources. Each adds f(gp - gn) to the fold nodes: the gp device drains to y, the gn device to x.
A: vinp - vref, B: vref - vinn, C1 = C2: vref - vfb. The loop forces f(vinp - vref) + f(vref - vinn) = 2 f(vfb - vref), so vfb - vref = (vinp - vinn)/2.
[2] fold: sinks SX, SY (gate vbn) and NMOS cascodes CX, CY (gate vbnc). x and y are the fold nodes.
[3] PMOS cascoded mirror: PL, PCL is the input side (gates tied to l2), PR, PCR the output side into node a. Cascode gates vbpc.
[4] class-AB control: ABP (gate vabp) and ABN (gate vabn) between a and b. With RP2 / RN2 [8] and the replicas RP1 / RN1 at pad level it sets the quiescent current of OP and ON.
[5] FPL, FNL: copy of [4] in the mirror input branch (between l2 and l1), so both fold branches carry the same element.
[6] the output devices OP / ON, their replicas RP1 / RN1 (dabp / dabn) and the dummy RPD are at pad level since 2026-10-28: d2s_out_p, d2s_out_n (the clamp frames).
[7] the Miller capacitors CMA (a to the pad) and CMB (pad to b) are at pad level since 2026-10-28, in the gap between the diodes. vfb is the feedback input (the pad).
[E] enable, en_3v3 (0 ... 3.3 V on vdd / vss, active high); en_3v3_b from en_ctrl_3v3. Disabled: SA pulls a to vddo and SB pulls b to vsso, so OP and ON (pad level) are off
with their gates on their sources, as in a clamp; SABP pulls vabp to vdd and SABN pulls vabn to vss, so ABP / ABN cannot conduct from one pull
into the other. Enabled: the four switches are off and the cell is d2s_mpdda.
[8] RP2 / RN2: the upper halves of the class-AB diode stacks (with FPL / ABP and FNL / ABN the AB groups of layout_primitives P7); their sources dabp / dabn go to RP1 / RN1 in the clamp frames.
[DM] dummies of the d2s layout cells, as drawn (pad_candidate.cdl, C2 2026-11-03); every one a device, D = S
PMOS (D = S = bulk = vdd): MDT inputs (tub, 2 x 10u / 1u), MDTL tails (gate vbp), MDL loads (gate l2), MDPC casc_p (gate vbpc), MDABP ab_p
NMOS (D = S = G, bulk vss): MDABN ab_n (vss), MDCN casc_n (vbnc), MDSK sinks + MDBNT the twin of BN (vbn); RD: the 2 dummy rhigh strips (vss)
[BA] backannotated 2026-11-03 from the drawn pad cell (C2): SX / SY ng 6 (6 fingers 6u / 6u), SA bulk vdd and SB bulk vss (decided 2026-10-31),
the dummies [DM], and the rhigh chains in unit_r2. BP / BN / BPC / BNC are drawn in the d2s cells but stay in bias_tree_pd (same flat netlist).
